blocks.en_text: So a couple of years ago,
blocks.zh_text: 所以几年前，

blocks.en_text: a woman I know who I'll call Maya,
blocks.zh_text: 我认识一位女士，我就叫她玛雅吧，

blocks.en_text: went through a lot of big changes in a short amount of time.
blocks.zh_text: 在很短的时间里经历了很多巨大的变化。

blocks.en_text: She got married.
blocks.zh_text: 她结婚了。

blocks.en_text: She and her husband moved for his job to a new city
blocks.zh_text: 她和丈夫因为他的工作搬到了一个新城市，

blocks.en_text: where she didn’t know anyone.
blocks.zh_text: 在那里她谁也不认识。

blocks.en_text: She started a new role working from home,
blocks.zh_text: 她开始了一份新工作，在家办公，

blocks.en_text: all while managing her dad's new diagnosis of dementia.
blocks.zh_text: 同时还要应对她爸爸新确诊的痴呆症。

blocks.en_text: And to manage the stress of all this change,
blocks.zh_text: 为了缓解所有这些变化带来的压力，

blocks.en_text: Maya doubled down on her physical and mental health.
blocks.zh_text: 玛雅在身体和心理健康上更加下功夫。

blocks.en_text: She exercised almost every day,
blocks.zh_text: 她几乎每天都锻炼，

blocks.en_text: she ate healthy foods,
blocks.zh_text: 她吃健康的食物，

blocks.en_text: she went to therapy once a week.
blocks.zh_text: 她每周去做一次心理治疗。

blocks.en_text: And these actions really helped.
blocks.zh_text: 这些做法确实很有帮助。

blocks.en_text: Her body got stronger.
blocks.zh_text: 她的身体变得更强壮了。

blocks.en_text: Her mind got more resilient, but only up to a point.
blocks.zh_text: 她的心理也更有韧性了，但只到一定程度。

blocks.en_text: She was still struggling,
blocks.zh_text: 她依然在苦苦挣扎，

blocks.en_text: often losing sleep in the middle of the night,
blocks.zh_text: 常常半夜失眠，

blocks.en_text: feeling unfocused, unmotivated during the day.
blocks.zh_text: 白天感觉注意力不集中、提不起劲。

blocks.en_text: Maya was doing everything that doctors typically tell us to do
blocks.zh_text: 玛雅做了医生通常告诉我们要做的一切，

blocks.en_text: to be physically and mentally healthy,
blocks.zh_text: 来保持身心健康，

blocks.en_text: and yet something was missing.
blocks.zh_text: 可还是缺了点什么。

blocks.en_text: What if I told you that what was missing for Maya
blocks.zh_text: 如果我告诉你，玛雅所缺的那样东西，

blocks.en_text: is also missing for billions of people around the world,
blocks.zh_text: 也是全世界数十亿人所缺的，

blocks.en_text: and that it might be missing for you?
blocks.zh_text: 而且可能你也缺呢？

blocks.en_text: What if I told you that not having it undermines our other efforts
blocks.zh_text: 如果我告诉你，缺少它会削弱我们在其他方面的努力——

blocks.en_text: to be healthy and can even shorten your lifespan?
blocks.zh_text: 那些为了健康的努力，甚至可能缩短你的寿命呢？

blocks.en_text: I’ve been studying this for over a decade,
blocks.zh_text: 我研究这个已经十多年了，

blocks.en_text: and I've discovered that the traditional way we think
blocks.zh_text: 我发现，我们传统上对健康的看法

blocks.en_text: about health is incomplete.
blocks.zh_text: 是不完整的。

blocks.en_text: By thinking of our health as primarily physical and mental,
blocks.zh_text: 当我们把健康主要看作身体和心理两方面时，

blocks.en_text: we overlook what I believe is the greatest challenge
blocks.zh_text: 我们就忽略了——我认为这是当今最大的挑战，

blocks.en_text: and the greatest opportunity of our time.
blocks.zh_text: 也是最大的机遇。

blocks.en_text: Social health.
blocks.zh_text: 社交健康。

blocks.en_text: While physical health is about our bodies
blocks.zh_text: 身体健康关乎我们的身体，

blocks.en_text: and mental health is about our minds,
blocks.zh_text: 心理健康关乎我们的心智，

blocks.en_text: social health is about our relationships.
blocks.zh_text: 而社交健康关乎我们的人际关系。

blocks.en_text: And if you haven't heard this term before,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你以前没听过这个词，

blocks.en_text: that's because it hasn't yet made its way into mainstream vocabulary,
blocks.zh_text: 那是因为它还没进入主流词汇，

blocks.en_text: yet it is equally important.
blocks.zh_text: 但它同样重要。

blocks.en_text: Maya didn't yet have a sense of community in her new home.
blocks.zh_text: 玛雅在新家还没有归属感。

blocks.en_text: She wasn't seeing her family,
blocks.zh_text: 她不再见到她的家人，

blocks.en_text: or her friends or her coworkers in person anymore,
blocks.zh_text: 也不再当面见到她的朋友或同事，

blocks.en_text: and she often went weeks only spending quality time with her husband.
blocks.zh_text: 她常常好几周都只和丈夫共度美好时光。

blocks.en_text: Her story shows us that we can't be fully healthy,
blocks.zh_text: 她的故事告诉我们，我们无法完全健康，

blocks.en_text: we can’t thrive, if we take care of our bodies and our minds,
blocks.zh_text: 无法茁壮成长，如果我们只照顾身体和心智，

blocks.en_text: but not our relationships.
blocks.zh_text: 却不照顾我们的人际关系。

blocks.en_text: Similar to Maya,
blocks.zh_text: 和玛雅类似，

blocks.en_text: hundreds of millions of people around the world go weeks at a time
blocks.zh_text: 全世界有数亿人一连好几周

blocks.en_text: without talking to a single friend or family member.
blocks.zh_text: 都不跟任何一个朋友或家人说话。

blocks.en_text: Globally, one in four people feel lonely.
blocks.zh_text: 全球有四分之一的人感到孤独。

blocks.en_text: And 20 percent of adults worldwide don't feel like they have anyone
blocks.zh_text: 全世界有20%的成年人觉得自己没有任何人

blocks.en_text: they can reach out to for support.
blocks.zh_text: 可以求助、可以依靠。

blocks.en_text: Think about that.
blocks.zh_text: 想想看吧。

blocks.en_text: One in five people you encounter may feel like they have no one.
blocks.zh_text: 你遇到的每五个人里，可能就有一个人觉得自己无人可依。

blocks.en_text: This is more than heartbreaking.
blocks.zh_text: 这不仅仅是让人心碎。

blocks.en_text: It's also a public health crisis.
blocks.zh_text: 这也是一场公共卫生危机。

blocks.en_text: Disconnection triggers stress in the body.
blocks.zh_text: 缺乏联结会引发身体里的压力反应。

blocks.en_text: It weakens people's immune systems.
blocks.zh_text: 它会削弱人的免疫系统。

blocks.en_text: It puts them at a risk, greater risk, of stroke, heart disease, diabetes,
blocks.zh_text: 它让人面临更大风险，更容易患上中风、心脏病、糖尿病、

blocks.en_text: dementia, depression and early death.
blocks.zh_text: 痴呆、抑郁症，甚至过早离世。

blocks.en_text: Social health is essential for longevity.
blocks.zh_text: 社交健康对长寿至关重要。

blocks.en_text: So you might be wondering,
blocks.zh_text: 所以你可能会想，

blocks.en_text: what does it look like to be socially healthy?
blocks.zh_text: 社交健康到底是什么样子的？

blocks.en_text: What does that even mean?
blocks.zh_text: 这到底是什么意思？

blocks.en_text: Well it’s about developing close relationships
blocks.zh_text: 它指的是建立亲密的关系，

blocks.en_text: with your family, your friends, your partner, yourself.
blocks.zh_text: 和你的家人、朋友、伴侣，还有你自己。

blocks.en_text: It's about having regular interaction with your coworkers, your neighbors.
blocks.zh_text: 它指的是和同事、邻居保持经常的互动。

blocks.en_text: It's about feeling like you belong to a community.
blocks.zh_text: 它指的是感觉自己属于某个社群。

blocks.en_text: Being socially healthy is about having the right quantity
blocks.zh_text: 社交健康意味着拥有适合你的

blocks.en_text: and quality of connection for you.
blocks.zh_text: 数量和质量的联结。

blocks.en_text: And Maya's story is one example
blocks.zh_text: Maya的故事就是一个例子，

blocks.en_text: of how social health challenges come up.
blocks.zh_text: 说明社交健康的挑战是怎么出现的。

blocks.en_text: In my work, I hear many others.
blocks.zh_text: 在我的工作中，我还听到很多别的故事。

blocks.en_text: Stories like Jay,
blocks.zh_text: 比如Jay的故事，

blocks.en_text: a freshman in college
blocks.zh_text: 他是个大学新生，

blocks.en_text: who’s eager to get involved in campus
blocks.zh_text: 很想参与校园活动，

blocks.en_text: yet is having a hard time fitting in with people in his dorm
blocks.zh_text: 却很难融入宿舍里的人，

blocks.en_text: and often feels homesick.
blocks.zh_text: 还经常想家。

blocks.en_text: Or Serena and Ali, a couple juggling the chaos of young kids
blocks.zh_text: 或者Serena和Ali，这对夫妻一边应付年幼孩子的忙乱，

blocks.en_text: with demanding jobs,
blocks.zh_text: 一边还要应对繁重的工作，

blocks.en_text: they rarely have time to see friends
blocks.zh_text: 他们很少有时间见朋友，

blocks.en_text: or spend time one-on-one.
blocks.zh_text: 也很少有时间单独相处。

blocks.en_text: Or Henry, recently retired,
blocks.zh_text: 还有Henry，他刚退休不久，

blocks.en_text: who cherishes time with his spouse
blocks.zh_text: 很珍惜和配偶在一起的时光，

blocks.en_text: and yet feels untethered without his team anymore
blocks.zh_text: 但没有了团队，他觉得自己像断了线，

blocks.en_text: and wishes he could see his kids and grandkids more often.
blocks.zh_text: 希望能更常见到自己的孩子和孙辈。

blocks.en_text: These stories show that social health is relevant to each of us
blocks.zh_text: 这些故事说明，社交健康和每个人都息息相关，

blocks.en_text: at every life stage.
blocks.zh_text: 在人生的每个阶段都是如此。

blocks.en_text: So if you're not sure where to start,
blocks.zh_text: 所以如果你不确定从哪里开始，

blocks.en_text: try the 5-3-1 guideline from my book.
blocks.zh_text: 可以试试我书里的5-3-1法则。

blocks.en_text: It goes like this.
blocks.zh_text: 它是这样的。

blocks.en_text: Aim to interact with five different people each week,
blocks.zh_text: 目标是每周和五个不同的人互动，

blocks.en_text: to strengthen at least three close relationships overall,
blocks.zh_text: 总体上至少巩固三段亲密关系，

blocks.en_text: and to spend one hour a day connecting.
blocks.zh_text: 每天花一小时去建立联结。

blocks.en_text: Let's dig into these.
blocks.zh_text: 我们来详细说说。

blocks.en_text: So first, interact with five different people each week.
blocks.zh_text: 首先，每周和五个不同的人互动。

blocks.en_text: Just like eating a variety of vegetables
blocks.zh_text: 就像吃各种各样的蔬菜

blocks.en_text: and other food groups is more nutritious,
blocks.zh_text: 和其他食物种类更有营养一样，

blocks.en_text: research has shown that interacting with a variety of people
blocks.zh_text: 研究表明，和形形色色的人互动

blocks.en_text: is more rewarding.
blocks.zh_text: 会更有意义。

blocks.en_text: So your five could include close loved ones, casual acquaintances,
blocks.zh_text: 所以你的五个人可以包括亲近的亲人、泛泛之交，

blocks.en_text: even complete strangers.
blocks.zh_text: 甚至完全陌生的人。

blocks.en_text: In fact, in one study that I love,
blocks.zh_text: 其实，在一项我很喜欢的研究中，

blocks.en_text: people who just smiled, made eye contact
blocks.zh_text: 那些只是微笑、进行眼神交流

blocks.en_text: and chit-chatted with a barista,
blocks.zh_text: 还和咖啡师闲聊了几句的人，

blocks.en_text: felt happier and a greater sense of belonging
blocks.zh_text: 感到更快乐，也更有归属感，

blocks.en_text: than people who just rushed to get their coffee and go.
blocks.zh_text: 比起那些匆匆拿了咖啡就走的人。

blocks.en_text: Next, strengthen at least three close relationships.
blocks.zh_text: 接下来，至少强化三段亲密关系。

blocks.en_text: OK, we've all heard of a to-do list,
blocks.zh_text: 好，我们都听说过待办清单，

blocks.en_text: but I would like to invite you to write a to-love list.
blocks.zh_text: 但我想邀请你写一份“待爱清单”。

blocks.en_text: Who matters most to you?
blocks.zh_text: 谁对你最重要？

blocks.en_text: Who can you be yourself with?
blocks.zh_text: 在谁面前你可以做自己？

blocks.en_text: Make sure that you invest
blocks.zh_text: 一定要确保你投入精力

blocks.en_text: in the names of at least three of the people that you write down.
blocks.zh_text: 在你写下的至少三个人的名字上。

blocks.en_text: By scheduling regular time together,
blocks.zh_text: 通过安排固定的相处时间，

blocks.en_text: by showing a genuine interest in their lives,
blocks.zh_text: 通过真诚地关心他们的生活，

blocks.en_text: and also by opening up
blocks.zh_text: 也通过敞开心扉

blocks.en_text: about the experiences that you're going through.
blocks.zh_text: 聊聊你正在经历的事情。

blocks.en_text: And I'm often asked, does it have to be in person?
blocks.zh_text: 经常有人问我，一定要面对面吗？

blocks.en_text: Does texting count?
blocks.zh_text: 发短信算吗？

blocks.en_text: Studies have shown that face-to-face is ideal,
blocks.zh_text: 研究表明面对面是最理想的，

blocks.en_text: so do that whenever possible.
blocks.zh_text: 所以只要有可能就这样做。

blocks.en_text: But there are absolutely still benefits to staying connected virtually.
blocks.zh_text: 但通过线上方式保持联系也绝对是有好处的。

blocks.en_text: And last, spend one hour a day on meaningful connection.
blocks.zh_text: 最后，每天花一小时在有意义的联结上。

blocks.en_text: OK, if you're an introvert, right now you're probably thinking
blocks.zh_text: 好，如果你是内向的人，现在你大概在想

blocks.en_text: one hour sounds like a lot.
blocks.zh_text: 一小时听起来好多啊。

blocks.en_text: I get it.
blocks.zh_text: 我懂。

blocks.en_text: It might be surprising, but I'm actually also an introvert.
blocks.zh_text: 可能有点意外，但其实我也是个内向的人。

blocks.en_text: However, keep in mind that just like getting eight hours of sleep at night,
blocks.zh_text: 不过，请记住，就像晚上睡八个小时一样，

blocks.en_text: the exact amount that's right for you personally
blocks.zh_text: 对你个人来说真正合适的量

blocks.en_text: might be higher or lower.
blocks.zh_text: 可能更高，也可能更低。

blocks.en_text: But if you are thinking that one hour a day sounds like way too much
blocks.zh_text: 但如果你觉得每天一小时听起来实在太多了

blocks.en_text: because you're just way too busy,
blocks.zh_text: 因为你实在太忙了，

blocks.en_text: I challenge you.
blocks.zh_text: 那我向你发起挑战。

blocks.en_text: Adults in the US spend an average of 4.5 hours
blocks.zh_text: 美国成年人平均每天花4.5个小时

blocks.en_text: each day on their smartphones.
blocks.zh_text: 在智能手机上。

blocks.en_text: So instead of scrolling on social media,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，与其刷社交媒体，

blocks.en_text: text a friend.
blocks.zh_text: 不如给朋友发条短信。

blocks.en_text: Instead of reading news headlines, write a thank-you card.
blocks.zh_text: 与其看新闻头条，不如写一张感谢卡。

blocks.en_text: Instead of listening to a podcast, call a family member.
blocks.zh_text: 与其听播客，不如给家人打个电话。

blocks.en_text: Maya put this into practice
blocks.zh_text: Maya把这个方法付诸实践，

blocks.en_text: by scheduling recurring hangouts with a new local friend that she made,
blocks.zh_text: 她和一个新认识的本地朋友安排了定期聚会，

blocks.en_text: by attending community events
blocks.zh_text: 参加社区活动，

blocks.en_text: and dropping cards off in her neighbors mailboxes,
blocks.zh_text: 把卡片投进邻居的信箱，

blocks.en_text: by planning trips to see family
blocks.zh_text: 计划去看望家人，

blocks.en_text: and inviting friends in other cities to come visit.
blocks.zh_text: 还邀请其他城市的朋友来玩。

blocks.en_text: And bolstering her social health
blocks.zh_text: 而增强她的社交健康

blocks.en_text: made more of a difference
blocks.zh_text: 带来的改变

blocks.en_text: than focusing solely on her physical and mental health ever could.
blocks.zh_text: 比只关注她的身心健康所能带来的都要大。

blocks.en_text: And I know this because Maya
blocks.zh_text: 我知道这一点，是因为Maya

blocks.en_text: is actually me.
blocks.zh_text: 其实说的就是我。

blocks.en_text: I am so passionate about sharing tools to be socially healthy
blocks.zh_text: 我特别热衷于分享让自己在社交上更健康的工具

blocks.en_text: because honestly, I need them too.
blocks.zh_text: 因为说实话，我自己也需要它们。

blocks.en_text: And the 5-3-1 guideline is one way that we can be proactive
blocks.zh_text: 而5-3-1法则就是让我们能主动

blocks.en_text: and intentional about our relationships.
blocks.zh_text: 并有意识地去经营人际关系的一种方法。

blocks.en_text: And that is really the point.
blocks.zh_text: 而这正是关键所在。

blocks.en_text: Be proactive and intentional about your social health.
blocks.zh_text: 主动且有意识地去关注你的社交健康。

blocks.en_text: So zooming out beyond the steps that you and I take individually,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，把视野放宽，不只局限于你我个人采取的这些步骤，

blocks.en_text: together, we need to shape a society that thrives through social health.
blocks.zh_text: 我们还需要共同塑造一个因社交健康而繁荣的社会。

blocks.en_text: Over the next decade,
blocks.zh_text: 在未来十年里，

blocks.en_text: I envision educators championing social health in schools.
blocks.zh_text: 我设想教育工作者会在学校里倡导社交健康。

blocks.en_text: And just like kids build their physical muscles in gym class,
blocks.zh_text: 就像孩子们在体育课上锻炼身体肌肉一样，

blocks.en_text: they'll exercise their social muscles in connection class.
blocks.zh_text: 他们也会在人际连接课上锻炼自己的社交肌肉。

blocks.en_text: Over the next decade,
blocks.zh_text: 在未来十年里，

blocks.en_text: I see our cities and neighborhoods
blocks.zh_text: 我看到我们的城市和社区

blocks.en_text: being designed with social health in mind,
blocks.zh_text: 在设计时会把社交健康考虑在内，

blocks.en_text: where vibrant gathering places foster unity
blocks.zh_text: 充满活力的聚会场所促进团结，

blocks.en_text: and community builders are empowered to bring them to life.
blocks.zh_text: 社区建设者也有能力把它们变成现实。

blocks.en_text: Over the next decade,
blocks.zh_text: 在未来十年里，

blocks.en_text: I believe that social health
blocks.zh_text: 我相信社交健康

blocks.en_text: will become as ingrained in our collective consciousness
blocks.zh_text: 会像今天的心理健康一样，

blocks.en_text: as mental health is today.
blocks.zh_text: 深深扎根于我们的集体意识之中。

blocks.en_text: Because not that long ago,
blocks.zh_text: 因为就在不久之前，

blocks.en_text: mental health was a taboo topic shrouded in stigma.
blocks.zh_text: 心理健康还是一个被污名笼罩的禁忌话题。

blocks.en_text: And now public figures talk openly about it,
blocks.zh_text: 而现在公众人物会公开谈论它，

blocks.en_text: there's an entire industry to support it,
blocks.zh_text: 有整个行业来支持它，

blocks.en_text: and more and more people think of going to therapy
blocks.zh_text: 越来越多的人把去做心理咨询

blocks.en_text: like going to the gym.
blocks.zh_text: 看作像去健身房一样。

blocks.en_text: In this future, loneliness will subside,
blocks.zh_text: 在这样的未来，孤独感会消退，

blocks.en_text: just like smoking subsided when we recognized
blocks.zh_text: 就像当年我们认识到吸烟

blocks.en_text: and treated it as a public health issue.
blocks.zh_text: 并将其作为公共卫生问题来处理后，吸烟现象逐渐减少一样。

blocks.en_text: In this future,
blocks.zh_text: 在这样的未来，

blocks.en_text: I hope that social health will become so deeply woven
blocks.zh_text: 我希望社交健康会如此深深地融入

blocks.en_text: into the fabric of our culture
blocks.zh_text: 我们文化的肌理之中，

blocks.en_text: that no one needs the 5-3-1 guideline anymore.
blocks.zh_text: 以至于再也没有人需要5-3-1法则了。

blocks.en_text: So to get there,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，要达到那一步，

blocks.en_text: make relationships your priority not only for you,
blocks.zh_text: 请把人际关系放在首位，不仅为了你自己，

blocks.en_text: but also for the people you love.
blocks.zh_text: 也为了你所爱的人。

blocks.en_text: Because the beauty of nurturing your own social health
blocks.zh_text: 因为培养自身社交健康的美妙之处在于，

blocks.en_text: is that it naturally enriches the social health
blocks.zh_text: 它会自然而然地丰富

blocks.en_text: of everyone you connect with.
blocks.zh_text: 与你相连的每个人的社交健康。

blocks.en_text: Thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 谢谢。
